story.title: These Fort Worth volunteers deliver food to students they’ll never meet
story.summary: Volunteers with Communities In Schools of Greater Tarrant County deliver food to students facing food insecurity. Michelle Boone checked each navy blue reusable bag. Apples, oranges, onions — all there. Then she spotted the red jars of Prego pasta sauce in a couple of bags. “Which schools get the Prego?” Boone asked her friend, Kim Norris. Nobody was sure. A quick call settled it: No school asked for it, so they split the jars among the bags. They finished loading Norris’ SUV and pulled out of the parking lot. Every Tuesday, the two retirees deliver fresh food to Fort Worth schools as volunteer nutrition navigators for Communities In Schools of Greater Tarrant County. The nonprofit’s on-campus program managers hand out the bags to students and their families who need the groceries.
